answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded stake: an agent must lock collateral before its voice counts, so every identity carries real cost. A gale of fake accounts, each spawned as easily as juniper seeds, would have to fund each stake, and provable fraud slashes the whole pile. Honest agents reclaim their stake at epoch close, so the expense punishes only fabricators while reputation accumulates like pigment in old paper - slow, visible, impossible to mint.
